rules.message_template: {model_name} needs a newer llama.cpp than AMD's ROCm 7.2.1 package (b8407) provides. Open the backend selector ([8]), pick llama.cpp ROCm (latest) or Vulkan, then [5] to update.
rules.evidence: Ornith's GGUF carries a trailing MTP (nextn) block; b8407 fails with missing tensor 'blk.32.ssm_conv1d.weight' (verified on an RX 9070 XT). Gemma 4 (April 2026) is newer than b8407 (March 2026), which cannot load it at all.
